limitation_notice: Formal results are bounded proofs over the modeled MotionFence state space; they are not proofs of unrestricted real-world physical safety.

properties.name: Human-Zone Actuation Prohibition
properties.description: If human_zone == OCCUPIED, valve actuation commands cannot be authorized (ALLOW is prohibited).
properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_001_HUMAN_ZONE_PROHIBITION).

properties.name: Cooling System Preservation
properties.description: An ALLOW authorization decision cannot occur if the cooling system is INACTIVE or DEGRADED.
properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_002_COOLING_PRESERVATION).

properties.name: Actuator Authority Isolation

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_003_UNAUTHORIZED_MUTATION_IMPOSSIBLE).

properties.name: Conflicted Knowledge Policy Gating

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_004_CONFLICTED_POLICY_BLOCKS_AUTHORIZATION).

properties.name: Stale Safety Knowledge Gating

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_005_STALE_SAFETY_CONSTRAINT_BLOCKS_AUTHORIZATION).

properties.name: Sensor Contradiction Gating

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_006_CONTRADICTORY_EVIDENCE_GATING).

properties.name: Temporal Cooling Preservation Across Horizon

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_007_TEMPORAL_COOLING_PRESERVATION).

properties.name: No Execution After Safety-State Drift

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_008_NO_EXECUTION_AFTER_STATE_DRIFT).

properties.name: Policy Version Binding

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_009_POLICY_VERSION_BINDING).

properties.name: Constraint Set Binding

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_010_CONSTRAINT_SET_BINDING).

properties.name: Execution-Time Validity
properties.description: Execution requires a currently valid authorization context — all bindings must match.
properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_011_EXECUTION_TIME_VALIDITY).

properties.name: Information Actions Cannot Mutate Consequential State
properties.description: Bounded information-gathering actions mutate only perception/sensor state and cannot mutate valves, pumps, or cooling.
properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_012_INFO_ACTION_NO_CONSEQUENTIAL_MUTATION).

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_013_PLANNER_CANNOT_AUTHORIZE_CONSEQUENTIAL).

properties.name: Evidence Budget Finite Bound
properties.description: Active evidence acquisition loop terminates deterministically within a strictly bounded iteration budget.
properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_014_EVIDENCE_BUDGET_FINITE).

properties.name: Evidence Acquisition Cannot Bypass Policy

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_015_EVIDENCE_CANNOT_BYPASS_POLICY).

properties.name: Additional Evidence Does Not Imply Authorization
properties.description: Acquiring new sensor evidence does not inherently guarantee or force an ALLOW verdict when safety invariants are compromised.
properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_016_NEW_EVIDENCE_DOES_NOT_IMPLY_ALLOW).

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_017_PLANNER_CANNOT_ESCALATE_ACTION_CLASS).

properties.bounded_model: Z3 SMT Formula: Refutation check sat=False under bounded state space (Rule PROP_020_ACTUATOR_FAULT_VERIFICATION).
